segment.source: The first matching policy wins. The chain policy for iPXE belongs first, so that firmware gets iPXE and iPXE gets its script.

notes.note: Help in the add dialog for every client type but iPXE.

segment.source: The new policy goes after the others of this scope. The order can be changed on the policies page.

notes.note: Help in the add dialog for the iPXE client type.

segment.source: The iPXE policy goes before the others of this scope, so that firmware gets iPXE and iPXE gets its script. The order can be changed on the policies page.

notes.note: Help in the add dialog for iPXE when a policy of the scope already has order 0.

segment.source: Another policy of this scope already has the order 0, so the iPXE policy shares it and the names decide. Change the order on the policies page so that the iPXE policy comes first.
